points.quote: Imported only in `workbench.desktop.main.ts`: desktop only. Examples are `contrib/files/electron-browser/fileActions.contribution.js`
Imported only in `workbench.web.main.ts`: web only. Examples are `extensions.web.contribution.js`, `terminal.web.contribution.js`
Desktop and web each have their own service registrations ... which supply the platform implementations behind shared interfaces.
A contribution is therefore loaded if and only if it is reachable from the entry file of that build

A file such as `contrib/<feature>/browser/<feature>.contribution.ts` registers its views, actions, services and settings as a side effect of being imported. Nothing runs unless some entry file imports it.
